environment.dataProvenance: In-memory dynamic synthetic fixtures (2 active properties, availability with 2 room types, quote calculation, 15-minute synthetic hold token, hold countdown timer)

isolation.network: Fixture server recorded 36 inbound requests from 127.0.0.1 (audited in network-audit.json). Browser network inspector observed 1 external font request to fonts.gstatic.com (cache attribution unverified). Inbound server logs alone cannot prove that the browser made zero other outbound requests; complete outbound network isolation is NOT claimed and NOT proven. Zero backend database connections were configured or used.
isolation.database: Zero database connections configured or accessed

browserVerificationMatrix.name: Initial Discovery State
browserVerificationMatrix.detail: Discovery returns nonempty properties (2 rendered) without auto-selecting property or querying availability/quote (0 room cards loaded).

browserVerificationMatrix.name: Explicit Property Selection
browserVerificationMatrix.detail: Clicking 'Chọn cơ sở này & Xem phòng' loads room inventory for selected property (2 room types: Deluxe Double Room, Executive Suite).

browserVerificationMatrix.name: Immediate Context Invalidation & Autocomplete
browserVerificationMatrix.detail: Typing into combobox invalidates previous selection, triggers debounced autocomplete search, updates aria-expanded, enables ArrowDown keyboard navigation and Escape closing.

browserVerificationMatrix.name: Clear Button Reset
browserVerificationMatrix.detail: Clicking clear button resets input value to empty and property selection to null.

browserVerificationMatrix.name: Synthetic Hold Reservation Navigation
browserVerificationMatrix.detail: Filling guest form and clicking 'Tiến hành giữ phòng 15 phút' triggers hold creation and routes to /booking/hold/tok-mv3domni-0vsdm with active 15-minute countdown timer.

browserVerificationMatrix.name: Rental Mode Button Toggle
browserVerificationMatrix.detail: Switching rental mode from overnight to hourly updates aria-pressed, adapts date picker from 2 controls to 1, and sends re-query.

browserVerificationMatrix.name: Date Range Edit & Late Quote Recalculation
browserVerificationMatrix.detail: Manual date picker editing and late quote recalculation were not exercised at runtime in browser session.

browserVerificationMatrix.name: Autocomplete In-Flight Loading State
browserVerificationMatrix.detail: Typing into combobox displays immediate loading indicator 'Đang tìm kiếm cơ sở lưu trú...' in popup DOM while request is in-flight.

browserVerificationMatrix.name: Autocomplete Empty State
browserVerificationMatrix.detail: Typing unmatched query displays 'Không tìm thấy cơ sở lưu trú nào phù hợp.' in popup DOM after debounced response.

browserVerificationMatrix.name: Computed Focus-Visible Retention under Tab
browserVerificationMatrix.detail: Tab navigation and activeElement tracking confirmed; source classes include focus-visible:ring-indigo-500, but computed ring retention under active Tab was not measured via CDP computed style/screenshot.

browserVerificationMatrix.name: Keystroke Debounce Throttling
browserVerificationMatrix.detail: Rapid keystrokes within 100ms throttle intermediate requests; single debounced query renders matching option.

browserVerificationMatrix.name: Delayed In-Flight Stale Response Order Race
browserVerificationMatrix.detail: In-flight race condition ordering was not exercised because the fixture server responds synchronously without artificial network latency.

browserVerificationMatrix.name: Exercised Browser Error Alert & Retry
browserVerificationMatrix.detail: Live fixture server returned 200 OK across all runs; browser error alert and retry button were not exercised at runtime. Component error state and retryLoadProperties() verified via unit test public-booking.page.spec.ts.
